description: This source file implements a fake angel socket listener and logging functions for a server, primarily for testing or simulated purposes. It includes functions to listen on sockets, handle errors, and log messages, with support for Unix and IPv4/IPv6 sockets.

methods.name: int li_angel_fake_listen(liServer * srv,GString * str)
methods.description: Creates and sets up a listening socket based on the provided address string, supporting Unix and IPv4/IPv6 sockets, and handles socket options and error cases.

methods.name: gboolean li_angel_fake_log(liServer * srv,GString * str)
methods.description: Logs a string to stderr, handling partial writes and errors, and frees the string afterward.

methods.name: int li_angel_fake_log_open_file(liServer * srv,GString * filename)
methods.description: Opens (or creates) a log file with append mode, returning the file descriptor.
